lead.event: BBRI reports nine-month 2026 earnings and operating performance
lead.headline: BBRI reports nine-month 2026 earnings as operating profit rises 15.38% to Rp61.24 trillion
lead.blurb: BRI attributed earnings growth to higher interest income, which rose 4.92% to Rp162.79 trillion, and expanded banking intermediation. Loans and financing increased 14.5% to Rp1,647 trillion, ahead of the national banking industry’s 13.26% growth rate, with MSME loans at Rp1,250 trillion. BRI expects MSME loan growth to be slightly corrected in 2027 amid anticipated inflation from El Nino-driven drought.
lead.copy_decision: rewritten: 6 new articles with a new fact: BRI expects MSME loan growth to be slightly corrected in 2027 amid anticipated inflation from El Nino-driven drought.

earnings_guidance.event: BMRI reports October 2026 earnings and net interest margin
earnings_guidance.headline: BMRI reports Rp4.6 trillion October profit as net interest margin contracts 89 bps
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bank Mandiri's January–October profit rose 19.64% year on year to Rp46.52 trillion, while October pre-provision operating profit increased 20% to Rp6.3 trillion. BRI Danareksa Sekuritas said a high loan-to-deposit ratio would keep margin pressure ongoing through year-end and maintained its buy rating with a Rp6,400 target price, citing December seasonal profit and interest-rate direction as catalysts.

earnings_guidance.event: BSML reports Q3 freight charter revenue growth and plans fleet strengthening
earnings_guidance.headline: BSML reports 48.39% Q3 freight charter growth and plans to strengthen fleet
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bintang Samudera’s total revenue fell year on year to Rp54.96 billion, while net profit was Rp2.12 billion. It operates 10 owned vessels and four under time charter, and plans to strengthen capacity and service quality to capture growth in commodity distribution and inter-island connectivity.

deals_control.event: BP sells its 49.9% APR stake to AKRA subsidiaries
deals_control.headline: AKRA subsidiaries buy BP’s 49.9% APR stake for US$14.22 million
deals_control.blurb: AKR Corporindo completed the purchase through AKRIDA and ADH, acquiring 11,444,565 shares and giving the AKR Group full ownership of APR. The sale ends BP’s participation in the BP-AKR Fuels Retail network in Indonesia.
